title: Sharp High-Probability Statistical Rates for Heavy-Tailed Nonsmooth Convex Optimization
summary: We establish sharp high-probability statistical rates for nonsmooth stochastic convex optimization under heavy-tailed noise, closing the confidence-dependence gap in both general convex and strongly convex settings. We consider composite objectives with a Lipschitz convex loss and a known proximal regularizer, accessed through fresh unbiased stochastic subgradients. The centered noise has conditional norm and directional $p$th moments bounded by $L^p$ and $s^p$, respectively, where $1<p\le2$ and $0<s\le L$.
